# taba_token (Data Source)

Reads one token by id, without the secret (the server only shows it at the creation). Needs authentication on and the root token or an `admin` token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads a token by id, without the secret.
data "taba_token" "ci" {
  id = "01JC8X3V5Q2W7E9R4T6Y8U0I1O"
}

output "ci_expires_at" {
  value = data.taba_token.ci.expires_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the token.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Deadline (RFC 3339), or null when the token does not expire.
- `name` (String) Name (not unique).
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions.
- `topic_prefixes` (Set of String) Prefixes the token is limited to (empty: every topic).
